effect:
A Ball for Water or Bug Pokémon.

3.5x catch rate on Water and Bug types. Checks the Pokémon's typing, not where you're catching it.

Water and Bug are literally everywhere so these get a lot of use. Stock up if you're doing any serious catching - 3.5x is better than Ultra Ball for anything that qualifies.
